candidate_windows.window_text:
The experiments in our paper required computational resources. We used 8 40GB NVIDIA V100 GPUs, Google Cloud Platform storage and CPU capabilities. We designed all our models to run on 1 GPU, so they did not need to utilize model or data-parallelism. However, we still need to recognize that not all researchers have access to this type of equipment.

We used Huggingface Bigbird-base models for our predictive tasks, and will release the code of all the custom architectures that we constructed. Our models do not exceed 300 million parameters.
